axis_xgmii_rx_64.summary: XGMII-to-AXI-Stream receiver: aligns lanes on start, detects terminate/framing errors in a 2-stage pipeline, checks CRC via LFSR, and a 3-state FSM emits AXIS beats with tkeep/tlast/error.

blocks.name: Receive FSM
blocks.description: Three-state frame controller sequencing payload, last beat, CRC reset and errors

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/PAYLOAD/LAST receive FSM controlling output beats, CRC reset and error flags

anchors.name: xgmii_start_d1
anchors.why: Delayed start detection that launches FSM into PAYLOAD

anchors.name: cfg_rx_enable
anchors.why: Receive enable gating frame start in FSM

blocks.name: Lane alignment and terminate detect
blocks.description: Realigns lane-4 starts, masks control bytes, locates terminate and framing errors

anchors.name: lanes_swapped
anchors.why: Set when start found in lane 4; selects swapped lane alignment path

anchors.name: framing_error_reg
anchors.why: Flags control characters inside frame, forcing FSM to abort with bad frame

anchors.name: term_present_reg
anchors.why: Terminate character detected this cycle; drives FSM end-of-frame decision

anchors.name: term_lane_reg
anchors.why: Lane of terminate character; selects tkeep and CRC check lane

anchors.name: term_lane_d0_reg
anchors.why: Delayed terminate lane used in STATE_LAST for tkeep and CRC selection

anchors.name: xgmii_rxd_d0
anchors.why: Lane-aligned masked data stage feeding CRC LFSR

anchors.name: xgmii_rxd_d1
anchors.why: Second data stage aligned with CRC result, source of output tdata

anchors.name: swap_rxd
anchors.why: Holds upper 32 bits for lane-swapped realignment

anchors.name: xgmii_rxd_masked
anchors.why: Input data with control-character bytes zeroed

anchors.name: xgmii_term
anchors.why: Per-lane terminate character decode used in swapped path

blocks.name: CRC checker
blocks.description: LFSR-based CRC32 accumulation with per-lane residue match flags

anchors.name: crc_state
anchors.why: Running Ethernet CRC32 state fed back through LFSR, reset between frames

anchors.name: crc_valid
anchors.why: Per-lane CRC residue match flags deciding good or bad FCS

anchors.name: crc_valid_save
anchors.why: Previous-cycle CRC match flags for terminate in lanes 0 and 5-7

blocks.name: AXIS output register
blocks.description: Registered AXI-Stream beat outputs with keep, last and user error

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: AXI-Stream output data from delayed aligned XGMII data

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Stream valid asserted by FSM in PAYLOAD/LAST states

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker set on terminate or framing error

anchors.name: m_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte-valid mask derived from terminate lane on last beat

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Bad-frame flag bit plus optional PTP timestamp sideband

anchors.name: error_bad_frame
anchors.why: Pulse reporting framing or CRC error on received frame

anchors.name: error_bad_fcs
anchors.why: Pulse reporting FCS mismatch

anchors.name: start_packet
anchors.why: Start-of-packet indication per lane alignment

blocks.name: PTP timestamp capture
blocks.description: Captures and adjusts PTP timestamp at frame start (parameter gated)

anchors.name: ptp_ts_reg
anchors.why: PTP timestamp captured at frame start, placed in tuser when enabled

anchors.name: ts_inc_reg
anchors.why: Per-cycle timestamp increment used to correct swapped-lane start timestamp

ungrouped_anchors.name: xgmii_rxd
ungrouped_anchors.why: 64-bit XGMII receive data entering lane-alignment pipeline

ungrouped_anchors.name: xgmii_rxc
ungrouped_anchors.why: XGMII control lane flags used for masking, start/terminate and framing error detection

axis_xgmii_tx_64.summary: 64-bit AXI-stream to XGMII transmit MAC: an FSM emits preamble, payload, padding and CRC32 FCS (from parallel LFSR instances), then enforces IFG with deficit idle counting and lane swapping.

blocks.name: TX FSM
blocks.description: Sequences preamble, payload, padding, FCS, error and IFG states

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: TX FSM: idle, payload, pad, FCS1/2, error, IFG

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: In-frame flag used to drop remainder and hold IFG

anchors.name: frame_error_reg
anchors.why: Frame error flag routing pad exit to error termination

anchors.name: frame_start_reg
anchors.why: Start-of-frame pulse capturing PTP timestamp and start_packet

anchors.name: cfg_tx_enable
anchors.why: Transmit enable gating input ready in idle

blocks.name: Input staging
blocks.description: Masked input word and empty-byte count register

anchors.name: s_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Staged input word fed to CRC and XGMII output

anchors.name: s_empty_reg
anchors.why: Empty-byte count selecting FCS/terminate placement in final cycles

blocks.name: CRC generator
blocks.description: Parallel LFSR CRC32 instances and FCS insertion muxing

anchors.name: crc_state_reg
anchors.why: CRC32 state per byte width, inverted to form frame FCS

anchors.name: update_crc
anchors.why: Enables CRC state accumulation during payload/pad/FCS

anchors.name: fcs_output_txd_0
anchors.why: Final data word with appended FCS and terminate code

blocks.name: XGMII output and lane swap
blocks.description: Output word mux and optional 32-bit lane shift

anchors.name: xgmii_txd_next
anchors.why: Next XGMII word muxed by state: idle, preamble, payload, FCS, error

anchors.name: swap_lanes_reg
anchors.why: Selects 32-bit lane-swapped output to start frames on lane 4

anchors.name: swap_txd
anchors.why: Delayed upper half word used when lanes are swapped

anchors.name: xgmii_txd
anchors.why: XGMII transmit data output from lane-aligned register

anchors.name: xgmii_txc
anchors.why: XGMII control lane flags paired with txd

blocks.name: IFG and padding counters
blocks.description: Inter-frame gap with deficit idle count and min-length padding

anchors.name: ifg_count_reg
anchors.why: Inter-frame gap countdown keeping FSM in IFG state

anchors.name: deficit_idle_count_reg
anchors.why: Deficit idle count carried into next IFG computation

anchors.name: frame_min_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining bytes to minimum frame length, drives padding

blocks.name: PTP timestamp
blocks.description: Parameter-gated PTP TX timestamp capture at frame start

anchors.name: m_axis_ptp_ts_reg
anchors.why: Captured PTP TX timestamp (disabled by default PTP_TS_ENABLE=0)

anchors.name: m_axis_ptp_ts_valid
anchors.why: PTP timestamp valid output, parameter-gated

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input frame data, masked by tkeep into staging register

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input valid starting frames; absence mid-frame signals underflow

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tready
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input ready driven by FSM ready register

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
ungrouped_anchors.why: End-of-frame marker moving FSM toward pad/FCS

ungrouped_anchors.name: error_underflow
ungrouped_anchors.why: Underflow error when input valid drops mid-frame
